Name: Wild Salmonberries and Blackberries
Author: stardewmoddingteen
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Want to see salmonberries and blackberries more often? This mod has you covered - Forage salmonberries and blackberries in their respective seasons with this mod.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]After unzipping the mod, place the folder named 'Wild Salmonberries and Blackberries' into your mods folder, and you can start playing!

[b]Main features[/b]
- S[/color]almonberries and blackberries spawn in Cindersap Forest and the Secret Woods in their respective seasons.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Describe the core features of your mod[/color]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
The SMAPI mod, the Content Patcher mod and the Farm Type Manager mod are required for this mod.

[size=4][b]Shoutouts[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A huge thank you to everyone playing with this mod![/color]

Manifest.Name: Wild Salmonberries and Blackberries
Manifest.Description: Allows salmonberries and blackberries to spawn in Cindersap Forest and the Secret Woods in their respective seasons.
